description: Template for Multi-Source Reasoning (MSR) question metadata generation. This template is used to provide context and instructions when generating individual sources for MSR questions.

variables.source_num: The sequential number of the source being generated (1, 2, or 3)
variables.source_type: The type of source (e.g., passage, table, graph, chart, email, memo)
variables.focused_skill: The specific skill this source is designed to test
